PRE-START (complete by Sept 6)
- Confirm hardware/laptop order and desk assignment.
- Create accounts: email, analytics workspace, issue tracker.
- Provision read-only access to the sanitized data warehouse before the first training session.
- Send welcome email with first-day logistics, building access, and a point-of-contact name.
- Schedule Day 1 orientation with Nora and a 30-minute team intro.

DAY 1 (Sept 9)
- Laptop setup, password manager enrollment, and 2FA activation.
- Verify login to email, analytics workspace, and issue tracker.
- Review security and data-handling policies specific to analytics.
- Meet with Nora for role expectations, 30/60/90-day goals, and sprint/board walkthrough.
- Complete HR paperwork and benefits enrollment if not done digitally.
- Lunch with buddy/mentor from the analytics team.

WEEK 1
- Attend analytics workspace training and issue tracker workflow session.
- Complete data warehouse orientation and confirm read-only access is functional.
- Shadow a teammate on an active analysis or dashboard review.
- Join recurring team standups and sprint planning.
- Draft a personal learning plan and share with Nora by end of week.

ONGOING
- Schedule 1:1s with cross-functional stakeholders.
- Complete role-specific compliance modules (data privacy, PII handling).
- Request feedback checkpoint with Nora at 30 days.","quality_notes":["Incorporated tip from onboarding specialist (C4) that analysts need read-only access to the sanitized warehouse before the first training session.","Checklist is time-bound to a September 9 start date and tailored to a data analyst role.","Covers account provisioning (email, analytics workspace, issue tracker) and early manager alignment with Nora."]}}
